summary: No functional discrepancies found. All 7 scenarios migrated with full structural control coverage (1/1 each) and correct behavioral output. Only instrument/capture caveats noted below.
instrument_caveats: UWP per-scenario golden capture unavailable: the original UWP app launched (ok:true, pid 44468) and its initial frame was captured (109KB, correct), but its CoreWindow (hosted by ApplicationFrameHost) exposes no traversable UIA tree to winapp on this host, so title-driven navigation and per-scenario/behavioral golden capture could not run. Not a uwp-app-runner failure.

WinUI 3 candidate screenshots capture as blank (~13KB) due to a known WinUI3/DirectComposition PrintWindow limitation; the same instrument captured the UWP CoreWindow fine. Rendering was confirmed present via the UIA tree (32 elements, NavigationView + all 7 scenarios, Description, Display, output — all on-screen, none offscreen) and live actuation (OutputTextBlock at real bounds 625,607 1379x391 with correct formatted output). Visual-layout parity could therefore not be pixel-verified, but content/behavioral parity is confirmed.
